base_paper: Madamidola, Ngobigha & Ez-zizi (2024), Intelligent Systems with Applications 25, 200472

stages.addresses: Faithful reproduction of the base paper

files.stage1_baseline_holdout.csv: Seven classifiers on known malware, beside the paper's Table 3
files.stage1_baseline_cv.csv: Ten fold cross validated F1 for the same classifiers
files.stage2_adaptive.csv: Fifteen withheld subtype detectors, beside the paper's Table 4
files.verification_report.txt: Dataset integrity, leakage guard and reproduction fidelity

stages.addresses: Faculty request: show our numbers against the paper's on the classifier page

files.papercmp_stage1.csv: Paired Stage 1 comparison, ours against the published figures
files.papercmp_stage2.csv: Per subtype Stage 2 accuracy, ours against the published figures
files.papercmp_zeroshot.csv: Classifier families over the 11 subtypes the paper reports
files.papercmp_context.json: What the paper does and does not publish, so the gap is explicit

files.upgrade1_tuning.csv: Default against tuned detectors, with the best parameter set

stages.addresses: Paper limitation: only Random Forest tested zero shot

files.upgrade2_comparison_summary.csv: Mean and worst case unseen recall per family

files.upgrade3_cross_subtype_recall.csv: Fifteen by fifteen detector against target recall matrix
files.upgrade3_hardest_subtypes.csv: Subtypes ranked by how hard they are to catch unseen
files.upgrade3_worst_blindspots.csv: The worst individual detector and target pairings
files.upgrade3_blindspot_diagnosis.csv: Feature level diagnosis of the TIBS blind spot
files.upgrade3_detector_ranking.csv: Detectors ranked by mean unseen recall

stages.addresses: Paper limitation 2, completed: they speculated about speed and never measured it

files.upgrade5_benchmark_Yash_laptop.csv: Per subtype timings and model sizes, Yash laptop
files.upgrade5_benchmark_summary_Yash_laptop.c: Latency, size and accuracy per family, with ratios to Random Forest
files.upgrade5_host_Yash_laptop.json: Exact machine the timings were taken on

stages.addresses: Literature limitation [6], [18]: balanced test sets and recall only

files.upgrade6_operating_point.csv: Per subtype precision, FPR and average precision at each prevalence
files.upgrade6_operating_point_summary.csv: Base paper configuration against ours at 50 and 10 percent prevalence

stages.addresses: Paper limitation: only one feature selection method

files.upgrade7_featsel_full.csv: Every method against every subtype, with the features chosen
files.upgrade7_featsel_agreement.csv: How far each method agrees with the base paper's choice

stages.addresses: Paper limitation: single run, no confidence intervals

files.upgrade8_arm_summary.csv: Mean unseen recall per arm with 95 percent intervals
files.upgrade8_significance.csv: Paired t and Wilcoxon tests on the two contested claims
files.upgrade8_per_subtype_tuning.csv: Which subtypes show a tuning gain that survives the noise

stages.addresses: Literature limitation [9], [24]: explanation quality asserted, never measured

files.upgrade9_faithfulness_ablation.csv: Per sample ablation of the top SHAP feature against a random one
files.upgrade9_faithfulness_grounding.csv: Each generated finding and whether it is grounded, with the text
files.upgrade9_faithfulness_summary.json: Headline rates, instrument controls and known limitations

significance_tests.Comparison: Extra Trees default vs RF default
